Output:

Q06 **Dominance (3.3):** ... Whenever one would enter discard, put it near map available instead. During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.
Q27 Removed faction pieces normally return to supply; tracked pieces return to the **rightmost empty track space**. Placement normally takes pieces from supply, or leftmost on a track. Items removed from the game are removed permanently. ... For simultaneous removal, remove all pieces before triggering removal effects.
Q35 **Vagabond setup (9.3):** Choose Thief, Tinker or Ranger; place pawn in any forest. Shuffle quests and display three face up. ... Take S-marked starting items listed on character: tea, coins and bags go face up on matching tracks, other items face up in Satchel; return unused S items to box. Place each other faction's relationship marker at Indifferent.
Q41 Each card requires: Recruit ... Place **one warrior at one chosen roost** there; Charismatic must instead place **two warriors** there ... If any required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns.
Q44 Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. ... Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt.
Q45 **Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**. ... Organize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement.
Q46 Merely battling there is not a trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it. ... Moving them into sympathy triggers Outrage.
Q48 An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**. ... Enemy Vagabond damages three items instead of being removed.
Q49 **Roll:** ... Each side's rolled hits are capped by its own warriors in battle. Alliance defending reverses the dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords instead of warriors. ... Vagabond is ... defenseless if it has no undamaged swords. ... Vagabond takes hits as item damage instead.
Q50 Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. ... To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item ... Damaged items cannot pay actions.
Q53 **Aid:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged item of any type**, give a card matching your clearing to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May then take one item from their Crafted Items box face up into Satchel/track; no available item is required to Aid. ... To advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction as many times **in this same turn** as printed between current and next spaces. One Aid counts toward only one improvement.
Q58 Explore ... Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot. ... Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed.
Q59 Coalition partners are not enemies. ... Coalition does not by itself grant Allied relationship powers.
Q60 **Hostile:** Removing **one** warrior of a non-Hostile faction immediately moves marker to Hostile ... **Infamy:** During battle on your own turn, score **one extra VP per hostile piece removed**, except warrior that first made faction Hostile. **Each hostile building/token removed in battle on your turn normally scores two VP: one removal VP plus one Infamy. A hostile warrior scores one Infamy, except the warrior that first caused Hostile status.**
Q62 During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. ... Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.
Q64 Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. ... Persistent effect (stone box): keep card in your play area and gain its text, subject to the personal duplicate check above. Its card is outside your hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.
Q66 1. Choose factions; determine starting player and seating randomly. Take faction boards and their listed pieces. Use Fall or Winter. ... 2. Put score markers at 0. ... 6. Distribute overview cards as desired; put battle dice nearby. 7. Set up factions in their letter order: Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond. Setup order is distinct from turn order.
Q69 Before-roll effects: Resolve applicable effects; attacker chooses order if both have them. ... After-roll effects ... attacker chooses order if both have them. ... The side taking hits ... also chooses order of effects triggered by its pieces' removal.
Q72 Every crafting piece gets its suit from the clearing containing it. ... **Marquise, Eyrie and Alliance cost:** For **each icon**, activate **one workshop, roost or sympathy in a clearing matching that icon's suit**, respectively. ... A **three-color question-mark icon** accepts any suit.
